description:
## Summary
- Restrict internal observability tracing via new `OBSERVABILITY_INCLUDE_PATHS` (default MCP/A2A allowlist).
- Honor `OBSERVABILITY_EXCLUDE_PATHS` after include matching and keep fixed skips for `/admin/observability/` and `/admin/events`.
- Harden observability DB writes (safe commit/rollback) and admin gateway registration timeouts to avoid hanging admin flows.
- Updated docs/config/examples and Helm values to reflect JSON array format and include/exclude behavior.

## Closes
- Closes #2068

## Detailed Changes
- `mcpgateway/config.py`: add `observability_include_paths` with default MCP/A2A regex list; clarify exclude semantics.
- `mcpgateway/middleware/path_filter.py`: compile include/exclude regex, apply include first then exclude, and skip admin observability endpoints.
- `mcpgateway/middleware/observability_middleware.py`: guard end-span/end-trace and avoid committing inactive transactions on close.
- `mcpgateway/services/observability_service.py`: safe commit helper with rollback logging to avoid noisy failures during contention.
- `mcpgateway/services/gateway_service.py`, `mcpgateway/admin.py`, `mcpgateway/services/catalog_service.py`: add admin read timeout for gateway initialization.
- Docs/config/helm: `.env.example`, `README.md`, `docs/docs/manage/configuration.md`, `docs/docs/manage/observability/internal-observability.md`, `docs/config.schema.json`, `docs/docs/config.schema.json`, `charts/mcp-stack/README.md`, `charts/mcp-stack/values.yaml`.
- Tests: updated include/exclude behavior in `tests/unit/mcpgateway/middleware/test_path_filter.py` and default MCP path in `tests/unit/mcpgateway/middleware/test_observability_middleware.py`.

## Behavior Changes
- Default tracing now targets MCP/A2A endpoints only (via include list), reducing admin/UI churn.
- `OBSERVABILITY_INCLUDE_PATHS=[]` enables tracing for all endpoints except fixed skips and configured excludes.
- `OBSERVABILITY_EXCLUDE_PATHS` is applied after include matching; invalid regex patterns are logged and ignored.

## Config Notes
- `OBSERVABILITY_INCLUDE_PATHS` and `OBSERVABILITY_EXCLUDE_PATHS` are JSON arrays (not CSV).
- Defaults: include MCP/A2A list; exclude `["/health","/healthz","/ready","/metrics","/static/.*"]`.

## Review Notes / Risks
- Broad tracing with `OBSERVABILITY_INCLUDE_PATHS=[]` can reintroduce high write volume; confirm acceptable for intended deployments.
- If CSV support is desired for include/exclude, add a parser similar to `allowed_origins` or document JSON-only requirement more prominently.
